messages:
marta: Handoff for the weekend watchlist — quick FYI and swaps. TL;DR: encoder-pool nodes 2/3 degraded (higher retry rate, no customer-facing errors yet), prefix-cache signal has intermittent fuzzing in eu-west, autoscaler noisy alerts on kv-autoscale (false positives during short bursts). I'm covering 12:00-20:00 UTC, @james covering 20:00-04:00 UTC. See runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/encoder-pool

james: Ack. I'll take the overnight shift. If encoder retry rate crosses 10% sustained for 5m, escalate. Otherwise just monitor and do graceful drains if node flaps. :+1:

sophie: Quick Q — for the prefix-cache fuzzing, is it still only in eu-west1 or are other regions noisy?

marta: Only eu-west so far. Telemetry shows spikes in prefix-cache-miss-rate around 02:xx UTC last night, correlated with a batch of long-context requests from a customer sandbox. Not customer impacting but triggers alert threshold.

alex: For encoder pool, quick mitigation is to reduce the pool's max_concurrency and force a rolling drain on the worst VM. Command to drain a node:

```bash
redwood infra node drain --pool encoder-pool --node encoder-07 --reason "retry-rate spike"
```

That should move in-flight work off and allow kube to reschedule. If node comes back flapping, mark it unschedulable and open a ticket.

ryan: For the noisy autoscaler alerts, we can mute the specific alert rule for a short window. Use: `./ops silence-alert --rule kv_autoscale_spike --until 2026-03-15T04:00:00Z --by oncall` — confirm before I run it.

marta: Go ahead and silence for 2h if you see repeat false positives. Leave note in the alert annotation with the reason + who silenced.

james: One more: I got a flake where encoder-03 showed degraded GPU health but returned to normal after restart. I scheduled a preventive reboot at 21:15 UTC if it stays flaky. Will post outcome.

sophie: I'll open a short PR to lower the alert sensitivity for prefix-cache fuzzing (increase eval window to 10m) and link the change here once it's up for quick review.

marta: Action items: (1) @james cover overnight and execute node reboot/drain if persistent; (2) @ryan silence kv-autoscale rule for short windows on repeat FP; (3) @sophie PR to adjust prefix-cache alert window; (4) @alex ready the node unsched procedure and tag infra ticket if we need replacement.

deploy-bot: Alert silence applied by ryan for rule `kv_autoscale_spike` until 2026-03-15T04:00:00Z — annotation: "oncall temporary mute, monitoring"

ryan: Silence applied. Will watch for any missed real incidents and unmute early if needed.

james: Reboot done for encoder-03 at 21:16 UTC. Post-reboot metrics look stable. Leaving it in drain for now, will flip schedulable once stable for 10m.

sophie: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/pr/4456 — patch increases eval window to 10m and adds a note in the alert text. Reviewing @marta @james when you have a sec.

marta: Thanks team. I'll leave this thread pinned in the handoff channel and update the watchlist doc with these notes. Ping me if anything changes. :eyes:
